study type: Predictive modeling study (using machine learning on retrospective data)
exposure: history of previous complications (stillbirth or abortion)
other maternal, fetal, and perinatal factors
cohort: The study utilized data from infants in Wad Medani, Sudan, including maternal, fetal, and perinatal factors to predict APGAR scores.
finding: An optimized machine learning model achieved excellent predictive performance for low APGAR scores, identifying gestational age, maternal BMI, mode of delivery, and history of previous complications as key predictors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as one of the key influential risk factors contributing to low APGAR scores.
gest_age: Gestational age was identified as a key predictor for low APGAR scores.
